# Keep Mbox fixture categories tied to their allowed consumers

Current mboxValidCases describes reversible input/output cases and is used by both the reader and writer tests. mboxOddCases and mboxAmbiguities exercise tolerant reading; their comments explicitly reject using those malformed forms as writer output. The 2024 build annotations retain these categories. Scoped test recommendation: add a case to the category whose expected transformation matches the reader or writer contract, rather than making tolerant input normative output. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mailnews/base/test.
